verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex documents automatic calculation, withholding, and remittance of taxes for every state where employees work. It also documents automatic tax filing and lists a State Taxes API resource, so the multi-state payroll and withholding core is covered. Nothing in the evidence shows Paychex handling the state registrations the story also requires, and there is no independent or hands-on confirmation of multi-state accuracy. Missing for 10: documented state tax registration/account setup per state, independent corroboration of multi-state withholding accuracy, detail on how per-state work/residence tax setup is configured.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run payroll for employees across multiple states with the right registrations and withholdings per state

citations.quote: Paychex automatically manages the calculation, withholding, and remittance of taxes for every state where your employees work
We automatically calculate, file, and pay your payroll taxes for you.
Stay ahead of changing federal, state, and local employment laws, with automatic tracking and alerts.
